data.long_description:
Experience modern family living in one of Dubai's most sought-after communities. This beautifully upgraded 4-bedroom + maid villa combines modern design, premium finishes, and an excellent location, making it an ideal home for families looking for comfort, privacy, and convenience.

Property Features:

Available Furnished or Unfurnished
Single Row
Park Facing
Walking Distance to the Pool
Upgraded Kitchen
Landscaped Garden with Real Grass
Electric Vehicle Charger
Spacious Living & Dining Area
Covered Parking
Bright, Open Layout
High-Quality Finishes Throughout
Family-Friendly Community

Whether you choose to rent it fully furnished or unfurnished, this exceptional villa offers the perfect balance of luxury, comfort, and flexibility. The upgraded kitchen, beautifully landscaped garden, and premium location directly facing the park create a wonderful living environment for the whole family.

Located in the heart of Arabian Ranches 3, residents enjoy access to parks, swimming pools, children's play areas, walking trails, sports facilities, and a welcoming family-oriented community. With its combination of premium upgrades, excellent location, and flexible furnishing options, this is a rare opportunity to rent a home that is ready to suit your lifestyle from day one.
